report:
Based on my research, the claim that ibuprofen worsens COVID-19 is **not supported by current evidence**. Here is a summary of how this concern arose and what the evidence shows:

**Origin of the concern:** In March 2020, a letter published in *The Lancet* (Fang et al.) hypothesized that NSAIDs like ibuprofen might upregulate ACE-2 receptors, potentially increasing SARS-CoV-2 entry into cells. France's Health Minister then publicly warned against using ibuprofen for COVID-19, triggering global alarm ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/story/the-ibuprofen-debate-reveals-the-danger-of-covid-19-rumors/)).

**WHO and FDA response:** The World Health Organization reviewed 73 studies and found **no evidence** that ibuprofen worsens COVID-19. The FDA similarly stated it was "aware of news reports" but found no compelling clinical data to support the claim ([WHO](https://www.who.int/news-room/commentaries/detail/the-use-of-non-steroidal-anti-inflammatory-drugs-(nsaids)-in-patients-with-covid-19); [FDA](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-alerts-and-statements/fda-advises-patients-use-non-steroidal-anti-inflammatory-drugs-nsaids-covid-19)).

**Subsequent research:** A 2021 *Lancet Rheumatology* review noted that early concerns were based on unpublished data and that no studies had demonstrated a causal link between ibuprofen and severe COVID-19 ([Lancet Rheumatology](https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lanrhe/article/PIIS2665-9913(21)00144-2/fulltext)). A PMC review concluded that the ACE-2 upregulation hypothesis lacked corresponding human evidence ([PMC](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7287029/)). Some studies even suggested ibuprofen might have beneficial anti-inflammatory effects in moderate COVID-19 cases.

**Conclusion:** The claim originated from a theoretical hypothesis, not clinical data. Major health authorities and subsequent research have found no evidence that ibuprofen worsens COVID-19. While some agencies initially recommended acetaminophen as a first choice out of caution, current evidence does not support avoiding ibuprofen for COVID-19 symptom management.
